decisions.reason: As a newly launched coolant-system upgrade that fits the firm's core process-media portfolio and supports higher machining performance, it is likely to be retained and cross-sold into existing customer accounts.

The coolant cleaning centrifuge strengthens the firm's value proposition in coolant management, and a large engineering-led German machinery supplier would usually keep such a strategic adjacent product to build integrated system sales.

Coolant nozzles are less differentiated and easier to substitute than larger systems, but they still complement the firm's installed base and help round out a modular offering, so the most likely decision is to keep them.
A scraper belt chip conveyor is close to the firm's established material-flow and production-support business, so keeping it supports a broad standard portfolio for metalworking customers.
The magnetic belt chip conveyor builds directly on the firm's existing chip-handling competencies and should remain attractive as part of integrated automation and coolant-management solutions.
A hinged belt chip conveyor is a conventional but important conveyor variant for factory customers, and maintaining it helps the firm serve different application needs within its broad product range.
